sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.limitations: Completeness varies by feature. Speeds are imputed from road class where maxspeed is missing.

sources.name: NYC Open Data facility layers + NYS DOH health facilities
sources.publisher: City of New York; New York State Department of Health
sources.role: School, library and NYCHA community center locations (cooling center sites), FDNY firehouses, bus stop shelters, Neighborhood Tabulation Area names, hospitals
sources.limitations: Bus stop shelters are a subset of all stops. Names come from NTA boundaries by tract centroid.

sources.name: Heat exposure proxy + NYC Heat Vulnerability Index
sources.role: Cell heat = 0.6 x lack of green/blue space within 300 m (OSM) + 0.4 x population density (ACS). HVI (1-5 by ZIP) scales the share of vulnerable residents without home cooling
sources.limitations: Not a measured temperature. HVI is joined to tracts by centroid.

sources.name: American Community Survey 5-year estimates (tract)
sources.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, via Esri Living Atlas 'ACS Context for Emergency Response'
sources.role: Population, age 65+, households without a vehicle, poverty, disability, limited English, no internet access
sources.limitations: Survey estimates with margins of error. Population is distributed along residential streets (dasymetric), so at-risk counts are modelled.
